title: Consolidation from .csv
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file and tube rack
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file in the required format and arrange up to 23 1.5 ml snap‑cap tubes in a 4 × 6 Opentrons tuberack, leaving the tube at position A1 as the consolidation destination.

substeps.instruction: Write a header line exactly as: Sample #,Position,Sample ID,Amt Lib (ul),Total Vol. (ul)
Leave any empty lines in the file; they will be ignored.

steps.title: Input pipette mount and CSV file
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, select the P20 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette mount and upload the prepared .csv file.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the Python protocol file that the App creates from the CSV and pipette settings.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the Opentrons App for execution.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the deck map: the 4 × 6 snap‑cap tube rack, Opentrons 20 µl tiprack(s), and VWR 5 ml tubes seated in an Opentrons 3 × 5 tuberack.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware positions, tiprack, and the P20 pipette (refer to Opentrons support articles for tip calibration).

steps.title: Execute protocol (Run)
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the sample consolidation protocol.
